blocks.tamil_translation: Salah he performs alone, he too is granted forgiveness,” Hazrat Sa'id ibn Musayyib (RH) states, through one of the Ansari Sahabah (RA), that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ مُتَطَهِّرًا إِلَي صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَأَجْرُهُ كَأَجْرِ الْحَاجِّ الْمُحْرِمِ، وَمَنْ خَرَجَ إِلَي تَسْبِيحِ الضُّحَي لَا يُنْصِبُهُ إِلَّاإِيَّاهُ فَأَجْرُهُ كَأَجْرِالْمُعْتَمِرِ، وَصَلَاةٌ عَلَي إِثْرِ صَلَاةٍ لَا لَغْوَ بَيْنَهُمَا كِتَابٌ فِي عِلِّيِّينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداود باب ما جاء في فضل المشي الي الصلوة، رقم:٥٥٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever makes Wudu at his home and goes out intending a Fard Salah receives a reward like that of one who goes for Hajj in Ihram. Whoever takes the trouble to leave his place for the Duha Salah receives a reward equal to that of one performing Umrah. Performing one Salah after another without doing any futile work or speaking any useless talk in between is written in the register of the high ranks,” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا يَتَوَضَّأُ أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُحْسِنُ وُضُوءَهُ وَيُسْبِغُهُ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ لَا يُرِيدُ إِلَّا الصَّلَاةَ فِيهِ إِلَّا تَبَشْبَشَ اللهُ إِلَيْهِ كَمَا يَتَبَشْبَشُ أَهْلُ الْغَائِبِ بِطَلْعَتِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever among you makes Wudu well, performs that Wudu perfectly, and then comes to the masjid only for Salah, Allah becomes pleased on seeing him, just as the family of someone who had gone missing becomes happy when he suddenly arrives,” Rasulullah ﷺ
